name: David Wehner
headline: Building European Healthcare Champions
summary:
At SHS Capital we are committed to Building European Healthcare Champions, by accelerating the growth of our portfolio companies. If you are looking for the right partner to bring your Healthcare company to the next level, reach out!

Investors can participate in a diversified portfolio of innovative healthcare companies via SHS funds. Our investor base comprises private and institutional investor groups with a long-term focus. We currently host investors from well-known family offices, pension funds, pension schemes, fund of funds, banks, churches, health insurance companies, industrial companies, the European Investment Fund, and the KfW.
